Shaker Kitchen Cabinets

The shaker door is the classic American cabinet door: a frame with a recessed flat panel in the middle. We build shaker doors in-house in our Oldsmar shop, painted in almost any color or stained to show the real wood grain.

  • Five-piece door: a frame around a recessed center panel
  • Classic look that fits coastal, traditional, and transitional homes
  • Usually finished with knobs or pulls in brass, black, or chrome

Finishes

  • Painted shaker. A smooth, solid color from white to sage to navy. Best for bright, classic, or colorful kitchens.
  • Stained shaker. The real wood grain shows through, so every door is a little different, and small marks blend into the grain over time.

Best for: Family kitchens, coastal and classic homes, and anyone who wants a kitchen that will not look dated in ten years.
